title: Anti-Rabies Vaccination for Dogs and Cats (Walk-in)
description: Free walk-in anti-rabies vaccination for dogs and cats at the Dipolog City Veterinary Office. Vaccination is done once a year.
schedule: Monday to Friday, except holidays. Exact office hours are not stated in the Citizen's Charter, so call ahead.

items: The dog or cat must be at least three (3) months old and apparently healthy

procedures.clientAction: Bring the dog/cat to the City Veterinary Office and log your details (name, address, birthday, purpose of visit, signature) in the logbook.
procedures.providerAction: Examine the dog/cat to make sure it is healthy and free from disease, and record the client and animal data in the barangay vaccination record.

procedures.clientAction: Hold the dog/cat for vaccination and wait for the vaccination certificate.
procedures.providerAction: Vaccinate the dog/cat, prepare and release the vaccination certificate, and remind the client of the do's and don'ts after vaccination.

contact.location: City Slaughterhouse, Brgy. Dicayas (address per the 2022 Citizen's Charter office list)

notes: Total processing time per the Charter: 18 minutes. No fee is listed for this service.
The City Veterinary Office also conducts mass anti-rabies vaccination in all barangays of Dipolog City on scheduled dates announced by barangay personnel.

title: Releasing of Impounded Dogs (City Pound)
description: How to claim a dog caught and impounded under the Dipolog City Pound Code (Ordinance No. 00-153), including the impounding fee.
schedule: Monday to Friday, except holidays. Exact office hours are not stated in the Citizen's Charter, so call ahead.

items: Order of Payment, 1 original (City Veterinary Office)

procedures.clientAction: Give details about your lost dog (date and place last seen, age, sex, color and markings).
procedures.providerAction: Check the daily impounding report in the City Pound logbook.

procedures.clientAction: See for yourself whether your dog is in the City Pound. If it is, inform the office, wait for the Order of Payment and pay the impounding fee at the City Treasurer's Office.
procedures.providerAction: Verify ownership by observing the dog's reaction to the claimant; if positive, issue the Order of Payment.
procedures.fee: ₱100.00 impounding fee (paid at the City Treasurer's Office)

procedures.clientAction: Present the official receipt and wait for the release of the dog.
procedures.providerAction: Record the receipt details in the logbook and release the impounded dog.

contact.location: City Slaughterhouse, Brgy. Dicayas (address per the 2022 Citizen's Charter office list)

notes: Stray dogs are caught under Ordinance No. 00-153, the City Pound Code of Dipolog City (November 14, 2000), and vaccinated against rabies when impounded.

Residents and institutions can request dog impounding by calling the City Veterinary Office or through the city's Sky One Command Center at City Hall. Barangays can request a dog-catching schedule through a letter to the City Mayor.
